title: Healthy Boundaries (Father-Focused)
description: This course supports fathers to understand boundaries in parenting and relationships, and how respecting boundaries creates safety for children and partners.
learningOutcomes: Understand boundaries in the context of fatherhood.
Recognise boundary violations that harm children or partners.
Learn how to set and respect boundaries safely.
Develop behaviours that support emotional and physical safety.

modules.title: Boundaries in Fathering
modules.content: Explores emotional and physical boundaries with children.

modules.title: Recognising Violations
modules.content: Shows how coercion and pressure harm family safety.

modules.title: Safe Boundary Practices
modules.content: Provides tools for respectful, safe interactions.
